Reviewed complete 34-tool turn, menu outputs and all save/wait outputs: unique supplied environment and live UI only, no AGENTS/coaching/alternate backend/sleeps. Both menu selections returned new conditional controls directly; all independent checks passed and completion observed. Zero tool errors. Retain four saving snapshots followed by separate waits (three after known flow), and five timeout 10000 values in seconds; every condition met promptly.

attempts.label: wizard-2-cu
reasons: Protocol deviation: task config omitted sourcing session.sh. Tool index 3 sourced only that config, so bare cu resolved via PATH, attempted untargeted click (rejected with observation_required), then observed a non-fixture app. Later calls restored the helper and supplied target and completed all expected states. Retain 240.218 seconds, 34 tool calls, one surfaced shell failure plus one masked CLI error; exclude from successful timing, no replacement. Both menu selections exposed expected controls. Full trace stays local; unrelated UI content is not exported.

runtime_context.classification: Fresh-profile cu-only retest; native controls are historical, with no global or project AGENTS instructions injected
runtime_context.working_directory: unique neutral directory per participant outside the repository
runtime_context.launch: codex --no-daemon exec, project_doc_max_bytes=0, features.memories=false; exact argv and context hashes retained locally
runtime_context.timing: One complete participant turn, including skill/API loading and task configuration. Profile provisioning, app launch, host process startup/shutdown, coordinator audit and cleanup are outside this timer.
runtime_context.limits: Same macOS user session, permissions, Launch Services, native CUA service/runtime assets and system caches; no VM/reboot/cache flush. Fresh profile, neutral cwd, exact disposable app identity and initial app state per participant.
runtime_context.comparison_scope: Six cu-only attempts across triage, document and wizard. Four predeclared historical clean blocks supply controls; no native reruns, no contemporaneous pairing and no pooling with repository-context blocks.

change_scope.description: Retest only. Benchmark coordinator supports selecting cu without planning native attempts. No production or skill change.

historical_plan.scope: Six cu-only full-task trials: triage, document, wizard; datasets 1 and 2. No native rerun or individual replacement. Retain all failures and recovery. Historical controls are not contemporaneous pairs.

historical_comparisons.classification: Historical matching datasets; not contemporaneous paired trials

attempts.label: document-2-native
reasons: Expected exactly one complete task turn
Interrupted turns have no complete timing; tool evidence retained

After six original sections were saved, participant reopened S206 instead of Move, then clicked the labeled window close button. Recovery queried inventory and bound generic VariedWorkflow names to a previous experiment app ID; coordinator interrupted with SIGINT to stop out-of-scope recovery. This task is incomplete and excluded, not replaced. All tool evidence retained. Initial runtime itself was clean: no global/project AGENTS injected.

menu_transitions.note: All selections exposed the updated Proxy field immediately; two occurred within the excluded task and are diagnostic only.

wizard_2.protocol_deviation: Omitted helper source from task config; one subsequent shell resolved cu through PATH without app targeting, observed a non-fixture application after a rejected click. Retained and excluded, not replaced.

findings.interpretation: Tool intervals are about 3–5% of accepted elapsed time. The remainder includes model inference, service/host scheduling and other inter-tool overhead; these traces do not isolate those causes. Historical controls are not contemporaneous pairs.
